title: 黄风岭借定风珠
subtitle: 看清方向，风也能帮忙
origin: 《西游记》第二十至二十一回（低龄温和改编）

moral.zh: 遇到混乱先稳住自己、看清方向，再向懂行的人求助，难题也能变成合作。
moral.en: When things turn confusing, steady yourself, find your direction, and ask someone experienced for help.

pages.zh: 黄风岭上忽然沙雾漫天，路标和脚印一下都看不清了。
pages.en: A sandy mist swept across Yellow Wind Ridge until road signs and footprints disappeared.
pages.prompt: Yellow Wind Ridge: four pilgrims stand safely together as gentle yellow sand obscures the trail. Exactly FOUR pilgrims: Wukong, Tang Seng, Bajie and horse. Sha Wujing has NOT joined, NO shaved-head bearded monk, NO extra fifth companion. Tang Seng is the same gentle young monk with a smooth round face, warm brown eyes, russet-and-gold kasaya over cream under-robes, a five-buddha crown and wooden prayer beads; calm, kind, softly smiling, with child-friendly rounded proportions.
